create_ModelOutput_subclass: create a dataclass subclass of ModelOutput to hold custom transformer model output fields
use_BaseModelOutput: use BaseModelOutput to store last_hidden_state, hidden_states, and attentions from a transformer model
use_CausalLMOutput: use CausalLMOutput to capture loss and logits from a causal language model forward pass
use_Seq2SeqModelOutput: use Seq2SeqModelOutput to hold encoder and decoder hidden states and cross attentions
convert_ModelOutput_to_tuple: call to_tuple on a ModelOutput instance to convert non-None fields into a tuple
